title: Crispy Corn Fritters
description: A simple and delicious snack made with cornmeal, perfect for a quick bite.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together cornmeal, rice flour, and salt.
2. Add chopped scallions and mix well.
3. In a separate bowl, beat the egg and add water. Mix well.
4. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
5. Heat a non-stick pan with cooking oil over medium heat.
6. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the dough mixture into the hot oil.
7. Flatten the dough mixture slightly with a spatula.
8. Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy.
9. Remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
